title: Safe or Not Safe?
retry: Listen once more and choose a pile.

items.text: You hold your grown-up’s hand beside the road.
items.note: Stay beside your grown-up near traffic.

items.text: You run into the road after a ball.
items.note: Stop and let your grown-up get the ball.

items.text: You wear your buckled helmet on your bike.
items.note: A helmet helps protect your head.
Keep your hands away from the hot stove.

items.text: You stay buckled in your car seat.
items.note: The buckle holds you in your seat.

items.text: You put a bead in your mouth.
items.note: A small bead can block your breathing.

items.text: You walk beside the pool with your grown-up.
items.note: Your grown-up stays close beside the water.

items.text: You climb onto a window ledge.
items.note: Keep your feet on the floor near a window.

items.text: You tell your teacher about broken glass.
items.note: Let a grown-up clear away sharp glass.

items.text: You poke a fork into an outlet.
items.note: Keep things out of electrical outlets.

items.text: You stop when your grown-up calls stop.
items.note: Stopping gives your grown-up time to help you.

items.text: You take medicine from the shelf yourself.
items.note: Your grown-up gives you the right medicine.

items.text: You put toys away from the stairs.
items.note: Clear steps give feet room to walk.

items.text: A ball rolls under a parked car, and you wait for your grown-up.
items.note: A parked car can start moving, so stay out from under it.

items.text: The light turns green, and you run across alone.
items.note: Cross with your grown-up after checking that traffic has stopped.

items.text: You leave your backpack inside during a fire drill.
items.note: Keep moving outside with your teacher instead of stopping for things.

items.text: You pet a friendly-looking dog without asking its grown-up.
items.note: Ask your grown-up and the dog’s grown-up before you touch it.

items.text: You tell a uniformed helper you are lost while you stay in the store.
items.note: Ask the helper to bring your grown-up to you.
